summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Sang Dhesian, a village in Punjab, India. It places the village in Phillaar tahsil of Jalandhar district and notes that it is known for the Baba Sang ji Gurdwara.
one_line: Sang Dhesian is a village in Phillaur tahsil, Jalandhar district, Punjab, India, known for the Baba Sang ji Gurdwara.
key_facts: Sang Dhesian is also written as Dhesian Sang.
Sang Dhesian is a village in Phillaur tahsil of Jalandhar district.
Sang Dhesian is located in the Punjab state of India.
Sang Dhesian is known for the Baba Sang ji Gurdwara.
